grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 3
grades.intro: Grade 3 is the year of multiplication and division. Master the facts, then use them for area, rounding and word problems.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 4
grades.intro: Grade 4 is the year of multi-digit multiplication, long division and fractions. Build fluency with big numbers, then use it for fractions, decimals, measurement and angles.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 2
grades.intro: Grade 2 builds strong number sense: facts within 20, adding and subtracting within 100 and 1000, place value, money, time and measuring. Short lessons and lots of practice make it stick.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 5
grades.intro: Grade 5 brings fractions and decimals to full strength: add fractions with unlike denominators, multiply and divide fractions and decimals, and find volume. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 6
grades.intro: Grade 6 is the bridge to algebra: ratios, rates and percents, dividing fractions, negative numbers, expressions and equations, area and surface area, and statistics. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 1
grades.intro: Grade 1 builds the base for all of math: adding and subtracting within 20, tens and ones, counting to 120, telling time, measuring and shapes. Short lessons with pictures, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Kindergarten
grades.intro: Kindergarten is where math begins: counting to 20 and to 100, writing numbers, comparing groups, adding and taking away within 10, and naming shapes. Short lessons with lots of pictures, then fun practice.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 4
grades.intro: Year 4 is the year of the times tables: pupils learn all facts up to 12 × 12 for the Multiplication Tables Check. They also work with 4-digit numbers, fractions and decimals, area and perimeter, and the 12- and 24-hour clock.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 6
grades.intro: Year 6 brings together everything from primary school maths ready for the KS2 SATs: long multiplication and division, fractions, decimals and percentages, ratio, algebra, angles, area and volume, and statistics.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 3
grades.intro: Year 3 builds confidence with numbers to 1,000, the 3, 4 and 8 times tables, column addition and subtraction, fractions, money, time and measuring. Short lessons with pictures, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 5
grades.intro: Year 5 takes numbers to a million and decimals to three places: long and short multiplication, short division, fractions and percentages, measuring angles with a protractor, area and perimeter, and line graphs.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 2
grades.intro: Year 2 builds number sense to 100: place value, number bonds, adding and subtracting 2-digit numbers, the 2, 5 and 10 times tables, fractions, money, time and shapes. Short lessons with pictures, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 1
grades.intro: Year 1 is where maths begins: counting to 100, number bonds to 10 and 20, adding and subtracting within 20, halves and quarters, money, time and shapes. Picture-based lessons and practice for 5 and 6 year olds.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 7
grades.intro: Year 7 is the first year of secondary school (Key Stage 3). Pupils extend their number skills with negative numbers, powers, primes and fractions, start using algebra to write and solve equations, and work with ratio, angles, area, averages and probability.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 8
grades.intro: Year 8 builds on Year 7 with index laws, standard form, expanding and factorising, equations with unknowns on both sides, straight-line graphs, percentage change, circles, prisms, transformations and combined probability.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 9
grades.intro: Year 9 completes Key Stage 3 and prepares pupils for GCSE: Pythagoras' theorem, trigonometry, similar shapes, quadratics, simultaneous equations, compound interest, volume of cones and spheres, and scatter graphs.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 3
grades.intro: Year 3 maths builds strong number skills: numbers beyond 10 000, adding and subtracting with regrouping, multiplication facts for 3, 4, 5 and 10, fractions, money, time and chance. Great preparation for NAPLAN numeracy.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 5
grades.intro: Year 5 maths moves to decimals with more than 2 places, percentages, factors and multiples, multiplying and dividing larger numbers, angles in degrees, area and perimeter, and line graphs. Great preparation for NAPLAN numeracy.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 4
grades.intro: Year 4 maths builds on Year 3: multiplication facts to 10 × 10, decimals with tenths and hundredths, equivalent fractions, larger numbers, money, time with am and pm, angles, symmetry and chance.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 6
grades.intro: Year 6 maths gets students ready for high school: integers, prime and square numbers, fractions, decimals and percentages, order of operations, the area of a rectangle, angles, the Cartesian plane and probability.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Foundation
grades.intro: Foundation is the first year of school (called Kindergarten, Prep, Pre-primary, Reception or Transition in different states). Maths starts with numbers to 20, seeing small amounts at a glance, adding and taking away, sharing, patterns, comparing, days and times, shapes, position and sorting, with a picture in almost every question.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 1
grades.intro: Year 1 maths: numbers to 120, tens and ones, adding and subtracting within 20, skip counting, sharing, patterns, measuring, shapes, position, data and chance, with a picture in almost every question.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 2
grades.intro: Year 2 maths: numbers to 1000, addition facts to 20, adding and subtracting 2-digit numbers, twos and doubling, equal groups, money, halves, quarters and eighths, time to the quarter-hour, shapes and graphs.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 7
grades.intro: Year 7 maths starts high school: square numbers and roots, prime factorisation, fractions, decimals and percentages, integers, ratios, algebraic expressions and equations, area and volume, angles with parallel lines, data and probability.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 8
grades.intro: Year 8 maths: index laws, recurring decimals and irrational numbers, percentages and profit, expanding and factorising, linear equations and graphs, Pythagoras' theorem, circles, rates, time zones, congruent triangles, sampling and probability.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 3
grades.intro: Grade 3 math in Ontario: numbers to 1000, adding and subtracting with regrouping, multiplication facts for 2, 5 and 10, fair shares and fractions, money and making change, time, measurement, data and probability. Great practice for the Grade 3 EQAO assessment.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 6
grades.intro: Grade 6 math in Ontario: fractions, decimals and percents, integers, ratios and rates, equations and inequalities, area of polygons, angles, the Cartesian plane, data, probability and financial literacy. Great practice for the Grade 6 EQAO assessment.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 4
grades.intro: Grade 4 math in British Columbia: numbers to 10 000, multiplication and division facts, fractions, decimals to hundredths, one-step equations, patterns, 12- and 24-hour time, polygons, perimeter, symmetry, graphs, probability and money. Great practice for the Grade 4 FSA.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 7
grades.intro: Grade 7 math in British Columbia: integer and decimal operations, order of operations, fractions, decimals, ratios and percents, two-step equations, linear relations, circles, volume, the Cartesian plane, transformations, circle graphs, probability and financial percentages. Great practice for the Grade 7 FSA.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 1
grades.intro: Grade 1 math in Ontario: numbers to 50, counting by 2s, 5s and 10s, addition and subtraction facts, word problems, halves and fourths, patterns, sorting and graphs, shapes, measuring, the calendar and Canadian coins.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 2
grades.intro: Grade 2 math in Ontario: numbers to 200, counting by 20s, 25s and 50s, odd and even, adding and subtracting to 100, equal groups, fair shares, patterns, graphs, shapes and symmetry, measuring in cm and m, time and money.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 4
grades.intro: Grade 4 math in Ontario: numbers to 10 000, multiplication facts to 10 × 10, multiplying and dividing by one-digit numbers, fractions, decimal tenths, equations, data, probability, angles, coordinates, elapsed time, area and money.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 5
grades.intro: Grade 5 math in Ontario: numbers to 100 000, facts to 12 × 12, two-digit multiplication and division, fractions, decimals and percents, ratios, equations, data, probability, triangles, transformations, angles, area and financial literacy.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 7
grades.intro: Grade 7 math in Ontario: powers and square roots, fractions, decimals and percents, integers, GCF and LCM, proportional reasoning, linear patterns, expressions and equations, circle graphs, probability, dilations, circles, surface area and volume, and exchange rates.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 8
grades.intro: Grade 8 math in Ontario: scientific notation, square roots and real numbers, percents, integer and fraction operations, proportional relationships, linear relations, equations and inequalities, scatter plots, probability, scale drawings, angle properties, the Pythagorean theorem and interest.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Kindergarten
grades.intro: Kindergarten math in British Columbia, with a picture in almost every question: numbers to 10, ways to make 5, making 10, change in quantity, repeating patterns, equal and not equal, comparing length, mass and capacity, shapes, concrete graphs, likelihood and Canadian coins.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 1
grades.intro: Grade 1 math in British Columbia: numbers to 20, ways to make 10, adding and subtracting to 20, equal and not equal, repeating patterns, measuring, shapes, graphs, likelihood and Canadian coins.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 2
grades.intro: Grade 2 math in British Columbia: numbers to 100, benchmarks of 25, 50 and 100, facts to 20, adding and subtracting to 100, equality symbols, patterns, measuring in cm and m, shapes, pictographs, likelihood and coins to 100¢.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 3
grades.intro: Grade 3 math in British Columbia: numbers to 1000, fractions, adding and subtracting to 1000, multiplication and division, one-step equations, patterns, measurement, time, 3D objects, graphs, likelihood and money to $100.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 5
grades.intro: Grade 5 math in British Columbia: numbers to 1 000 000, decimals to thousandths, equivalent fractions, multiplication and division, one-step equations, area and perimeter, time, prisms and pyramids, transformations, double bar graphs, probability and money.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 6
grades.intro: Grade 6 math in British Columbia: thousandths to billions, GCF and LCM, mixed numbers, ratios, percents and discounts, order of operations, decimals, equations, patterns, area, angles, volume, triangles, transformations, line graphs, probability and budgeting.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 8
grades.intro: Grade 8 math in British Columbia: squares, cubes and roots, percents, proportional reasoning, fraction operations, expressions, two-step equations, linear relations, surface area and volume, the Pythagorean theorem, views and nets, central tendency, probability and best buys.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 9
grades.intro: Mathematics 9 in British Columbia: exponent laws, rational numbers, polynomials, multi-step linear equations, linear relations and graphs, similar shapes and scale, statistics in society, and budgets.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Primary 1
grades.intro: Primary 1 maths in Singapore: numbers to 100, addition and subtraction, first steps in multiplication and division, money, length in centimetres, telling time, 2D shapes and picture graphs.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Primary 2
grades.intro: Primary 2 maths in Singapore: numbers to 1000, odd and even numbers, adding and subtracting to 3 digits, multiplication tables of 2, 3, 4, 5 and 10, fractions, money, length, mass and volume, time, 2D and 3D shapes and picture graphs with scales.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Primary 3
grades.intro: Primary 3 maths in Singapore: numbers to 10 000, 4-digit addition and subtraction, multiplication tables of 6 to 9, division with remainder, equivalent fractions, money, compound units, time and the 24-hour clock, area and perimeter, angles, parallel lines and bar graphs.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Primary 4
grades.intro: Primary 4 maths in Singapore: numbers to 100 000, rounding, factors and multiples, multiplication and division, mixed numbers and fractions of a set, decimals to 3 places, area and perimeter, angles, symmetry, nets, tables, line graphs and pie charts.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Primary 5
grades.intro: Primary 5 maths in Singapore: numbers to 10 million, order of operations, fractions and division, mixed numbers, decimals and unit conversion, percentage, discount and GST, rate, area of triangles, volume, angles, triangles and special quadrilaterals.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Primary 6
grades.intro: Primary 6 maths in Singapore: dividing fractions, percentage increase and decrease, ratio, algebra, circles, volume, angles in composite figures and average, with PSLE-style word problems and the model method. Great practice for the PSLE.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Secondary 1
grades.intro: Secondary 1 maths in Singapore (G3 Mathematics, formerly Express): primes, HCF and LCM, integers, approximation, ratio, percentage, rate and speed, algebra, linear equations and graphs, angles and polygons, area and volume. Short lessons and O-Level style practice.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Secondary 2
grades.intro: Secondary 2 maths in Singapore (G3 Mathematics, formerly Express): expansion and factorisation, algebraic fractions, simultaneous and quadratic equations, inequalities, proportion and map scales, congruence and similarity, Pythagoras' theorem and trigonometry, volume, statistics and probability.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Secondary 3
grades.intro: Secondary 3 maths in Singapore (G3 Mathematics, O-Level): indices and standard form, the quadratic formula, fractional equations, inequalities, graphs of quadratic, power and exponential functions, coordinate geometry, similar figures, sine and cosine rules, bearings, radians and circle properties.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Secondary 4
grades.intro: Secondary 4 maths in Singapore (G3 Mathematics, O-Level year): sets and Venn diagrams, matrices, vectors, problems in three dimensions, cumulative frequency and box plots, standard deviation and probability of combined events. O-Level style practice with full worked answers.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 7
grades.intro: Grade 7 is the year of negative numbers and proportional thinking: add, subtract, multiply and divide integers and rational numbers, solve two-step equations and inequalities, work with percents, scale drawings, circles and probability. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 8
grades.intro: Grade 8 is the year of linear equations and functions: solve equations, find slope, graph lines, solve systems, and use exponents, roots, the Pythagorean theorem, transformations and volume. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Algebra 1
grades.intro: Algebra 1 is the first high school math course: solve equations and inequalities, work with functions, graph lines and solve systems, use exponents and exponential models, then factor and solve quadratics. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Geometry
grades.intro: Geometry is the high school course on shape and proof: reason about lines and angles, prove triangles congruent and similar, use the Pythagorean theorem and trigonometry, and work with circles, coordinates and volume. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Algebra 2
grades.intro: Algebra 2 builds on Algebra 1: complex numbers, polynomial and rational functions, radicals, inverse functions, exponential and logarithmic functions, trigonometric functions and the normal distribution. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Precalculus
grades.intro: Precalculus prepares students for calculus: rational functions and asymptotes, trigonometric identities and equations, inverse trigonometric functions, complex numbers in polar form, vectors and matrices, the binomial theorem, conic sections, counting and expected value. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國小一年級
grades.intro: 國小一年級數學（108課綱）：100 以內的數、數數與順序、加法與減法的意思、基本加減法、二位數加減、算式與等號、認識錢幣、比長短、日期與時間、認識形狀、分類與整理。每個單元100題練習，題目短、圖多，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國小二年級
grades.intro: 國小二年級數學（108課綱）：1000 以內的數、加減直式（進位、退位）、加減應用與估算、錢幣、乘法的意義和九九乘法、分裝與平分、兩步驟問題、單位分數、公分和公尺、容量重量面積、幾時幾分、年月日、平面和立體形狀、分類。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國小三年級
grades.intro: 國小三年級數學（108課綱）：10000以內的數、加減直式、乘法與除法、兩步驟應用問題、分數與一位小數、數線與毫米、公升與毫升、公斤與公克、時間、角、正方形和長方形、圓、面積、表格與規律。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國小四年級
grades.intro: 國小四年級數學（108課綱）：一億以內的數、多位數乘除直式、概數與四捨五入、假分數與帶分數、等值分數、二位小數、角度與量角器、垂直與平行、三角形與四邊形、面積與周長、體積、時間與24小時制、併式與四則運算、長條圖與折線圖。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國小五年級
grades.intro: 國小五年級數學（108課綱）：兆到千分位、因數與倍數、約分通分與異分母分數、分數和小數的乘除、百分率與折扣、公畝公頃與公噸、三角形與四邊形的面積、扇形、線對稱、正方體和長方體的體積與表面積、柱體與錐體、平均與分配律、折線圖。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國小六年級
grades.intro: 國小六年級數學（108課綱）：質因數分解、最大公因數與最小公倍數、分數和小數的除法、比與比值、速度、基準量與比較量、放大縮小與比例尺、圓周長與圓面積、柱體體積與表面積、數量關係、雞兔與年齡問題、圓形圖與可能性。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國中七年級
grades.intro: 國中七年級數學（108課綱）：正負數與數線、絕對值、整數和分數的四則運算、指數與科學記號、質因數分解、一元一次方程式、二元一次聯立方程式、坐標平面、比例式與正反比、一元一次不等式、三視圖與線對稱、統計圖表與平均數、中位數、眾數。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國中八年級
grades.intro: 國中八年級數學（108課綱）：乘法公式、多項式的運算、平方根與根式運算、畢氏定理與距離公式、因式分解（提公因式、乘法公式、十字交乘）、一元二次方程式、數列與級數、一次函數、角與平行線、多邊形內角和、三角形全等與性質、平行四邊形與特殊四邊形、累積次數與相對次數。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.name: Classe quinta
grades.intro: Matematica in classe quinta: grandi numeri, numeri relativi e romani, numeri decimali e operazioni, divisioni con due cifre al divisore, multipli, divisori e numeri primi, potenze, espressioni, frazioni, percentuali, compravendita, problemi, misure ed equivalenze, perimetro e area dei poligoni, cerchio, volume, trasformazioni e piano cartesiano, statistica e probabilità (prove INVALSI). 100 esercizi con le soluzioni per argomento e schede da stampare.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: Prima media
grades.intro: Matematica in prima media: insiemi, numeri naturali e proprietà delle operazioni, potenze, espressioni, divisibilità e numeri primi, MCD e mcm, frazioni e operazioni con le frazioni, enti geometrici e segmenti, angoli, rette parallele e perpendicolari, triangoli, poligoni e quadrilateri, statistica. 100 esercizi con le soluzioni per argomento e schede da stampare.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: Seconda media
grades.intro: Matematica in seconda media: numeri decimali e frazioni generatrici, radice quadrata, rapporti e proporzioni, proporzionalità diretta e inversa, percentuali, piano cartesiano, area dei poligoni, teorema di Pitagora e sue applicazioni, trasformazioni isometriche, similitudine e teorema di Talete, probabilità. 100 esercizi con le soluzioni per argomento e schede da stampare.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: Terza media
grades.intro: Matematica in terza media: numeri relativi e operazioni, calcolo letterale, monomi e polinomi, prodotti notevoli, equazioni di primo grado e problemi, piano cartesiano e retta, circonferenza e cerchio, poliedri, prismi e piramidi, cilindro, cono e sfera, probabilità di eventi composti, statistica. 100 esercizi con le soluzioni per argomento e schede da stampare.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: Prima liceo
grades.intro: Matematica in prima liceo (liceo scientifico): insiemi e logica, numeri naturali, interi e razionali, monomi e polinomi, prodotti notevoli, scomposizione in fattori, divisione tra polinomi e regola di Ruffini, equazioni e disequazioni lineari, funzioni, statistica, triangoli e criteri di congruenza, rette perpendicolari e parallele. 100 esercizi con le soluzioni per argomento e schede da stampare.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: Seconda liceo
grades.intro: Matematica in seconda liceo (liceo scientifico): frazioni algebriche, equazioni fratte e letterali, sistemi lineari, radicali, piano cartesiano e retta, equazioni e disequazioni di secondo grado, parallelogrammi e trapezi, circonferenza e poligoni inscritti, equivalenza e teoremi di Euclide e di Pitagora, similitudine e teorema di Talete, probabilità. 100 esercizi con le soluzioni per argomento e schede da stampare.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: Terza liceo
grades.intro: Matematica in terza liceo (liceo scientifico): equazioni e disequazioni con valore assoluto e irrazionali, funzioni e loro proprietà, successioni e progressioni, retta e fasci di rette, parabola, circonferenza nel piano cartesiano, ellisse, iperbole, trasformazioni geometriche, statistica bivariata. 100 esercizi con le soluzioni per argomento e schede da stampare.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: Quarta liceo
grades.intro: Matematica in quarta liceo (liceo scientifico): funzione esponenziale, logaritmi, equazioni e disequazioni esponenziali e logaritmiche, goniometria, formule goniometriche, equazioni e disequazioni goniometriche, trigonometria, numeri complessi, geometria nello spazio, calcolo combinatorio, probabilità condizionata e teorema di Bayes. 100 esercizi con le soluzioni per argomento e schede da stampare.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: Quinta liceo
grades.intro: Matematica in quinta liceo (liceo scientifico, anno dell’esame di Stato): geometria analitica nello spazio, dominio e segno di una funzione, limiti, forme indeterminate e limiti notevoli, continuità e asintoti, derivate, teoremi di Rolle, Lagrange e De l’Hôpital, massimi, minimi e flessi, studio di funzione, integrali indefiniti e definiti, aree e volumi, equazioni differenziali, distribuzioni di probabilità. 100 esercizi con le soluzioni per argomento e schede da stampare.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: 3º ano
grades.intro: Matemática no 3º ano do Ensino Fundamental: números até 9.999, valor posicional, cálculo mental, adição e subtração com reagrupamento, tabuada, multiplicação e divisão, metade e terça parte, sequências, figuras geométricas, medidas de comprimento, massa e capacidade, horas, sistema monetário, tabelas, gráficos e probabilidade. 100 exercícios com gabarito por conteúdo e atividades para imprimir.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: 5º ano
grades.intro: Matemática no 5º ano do Ensino Fundamental (ano do SAEB): números até centenas de milhar, números decimais, frações, frações equivalentes, porcentagem, as quatro operações com naturais e decimais, problemas de contagem, igualdade e termo desconhecido, proporcionalidade, plano cartesiano, prismas e pirâmides, polígonos, ampliação e redução, transformação de unidades, perímetro, área, volume, probabilidade, tabelas e gráficos. 100 exercícios com gabarito por conteúdo e atividades para imprimir.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: 4º ano
grades.intro: Matemática no 4º ano do Ensino Fundamental: números até dezenas de milhar, adição e subtração, relações entre as operações, propriedades e cálculo mental, multiplicação, divisão, problemas de contagem, frações unitárias, décimos e centésimos, sequências e múltiplos, igualdade, localização, prismas e pirâmides, ângulos retos, simetria, medidas, área, horas, temperatura, dinheiro, probabilidade, tabelas e gráficos. 100 exercícios com gabarito por conteúdo e atividades para imprimir.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: 2º ano
grades.intro: Matemática no 2º ano do Ensino Fundamental: números até 1.000, comparar e ordenar, compor e decompor, estimar quantidades, fatos básicos e problemas de adição e subtração, multiplicação por 2, 3, 4 e 5, dobro, metade, triplo e terça parte, sequências e padrões, localização, figuras geométricas, medidas, calendário, horas, dinheiro, probabilidade, tabelas, gráficos e pesquisas. 100 exercícios com gabarito por conteúdo e atividades para imprimir.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: 1º ano
grades.intro: Matemática no 1º ano do Ensino Fundamental: números até 100, ordinais, contar e estimar, comparar números, dezenas e unidades, adição e subtração até 20, problemas, classificar objetos, sequências, localização, figuras geométricas, comprimento, massa e capacidade, períodos do dia, calendário, dinheiro, probabilidade, tabelas e pesquisas. 100 exercícios com gabarito por conteúdo e atividades para imprimir.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: 9º ano
grades.intro: Matemática no 9º ano do Ensino Fundamental: números reais e irracionais, potências e radicais, notação científica, porcentagens e juros compostos, funções, proporcionalidade, produtos notáveis, fatoração e equações do 2º grau, ângulos e circunferência, semelhança, relações métricas e teorema de Pitágoras, plano cartesiano, vistas, volume, probabilidade e estatística. 100 exercícios com gabarito por conteúdo e atividades para imprimir.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: 6º ano
grades.intro: Matemática no 6º ano do Ensino Fundamental: números naturais e sistema de numeração, operações e expressões numéricas, múltiplos, divisores e números primos, MMC e MDC, frações e números decimais, porcentagem, igualdade e partilha, plano cartesiano, prismas e pirâmides, polígonos, ampliação e redução, retas paralelas e perpendiculares, ângulos, medidas, perímetro e área, probabilidade, tabelas e gráficos. 100 exercícios com gabarito por conteúdo e atividades para imprimir.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: 7º ano
grades.intro: Matemática no 7º ano do Ensino Fundamental: múltiplos e divisores, números inteiros e racionais e suas operações, frações e seus significados, porcentagem com acréscimos e descontos, linguagem algébrica, sequências, equações do 1º grau, proporcionalidade, transformações no plano cartesiano, ângulos e retas paralelas, triângulos, polígonos, circunferência, área, volume, probabilidade, média e gráficos de setores. 100 exercícios com gabarito por conteúdo e atividades para imprimir.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: 8º ano
grades.intro: Matemática no 8º ano do Ensino Fundamental: potências e notação científica, radiciação, princípio multiplicativo, porcentagens, dízimas periódicas, expressões algébricas, equações com duas incógnitas, sistemas de equações, equações do 2º grau do tipo ax² = b, sequências, grandezas proporcionais, congruência de triângulos, mediatriz e bissetriz, transformações geométricas, área do círculo, volume e capacidade, probabilidade, classes de frequência, média, moda e mediana e pesquisa amostral. 100 exercícios com gabarito por conteúdo e atividades para imprimir.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: 1ª série
grades.intro: Matemática na 1ª série do Ensino Médio, de acordo com a BNCC: notação científica e medidas, grandezas compostas, funções e taxa de variação, função afim, função quadrática, máximo e mínimo, funções definidas por partes, progressões aritméticas e geométricas, função exponencial, logaritmos, função logarítmica, sistemas lineares, tabelas e gráficos estatísticos e medidas de dispersão. 100 exercícios com gabarito por conteúdo e atividades para imprimir.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: 2ª série
grades.intro: Matemática na 2ª série do Ensino Médio, de acordo com a BNCC: trigonometria no triângulo retângulo, leis dos senos e dos cossenos, ciclo trigonométrico, funções seno e cosseno, transformações e homotetias, áreas de superfícies, polígonos regulares e ladrilhamentos, prismas e pirâmides, cilindros, cones e esferas, princípio de Cavalieri, contagem, análise combinatória e probabilidade. 100 exercícios com gabarito por conteúdo e atividades para imprimir.

grades.subject: matematica
grades.name: 3ª série
grades.intro: Matemática na 3ª série do Ensino Médio, de acordo com a BNCC: juros simples e compostos, orçamento e financiamentos, taxas e índices socioeconômicos, modelos com funções, histograma, box-plot e ramo-e-folhas, pesquisa amostral e margem de erro, correlação e reta de ajuste, algoritmos e fluxogramas, introdução à programação e escalas e projeções cartográficas. 100 exercícios com gabarito por conteúdo e atividades para imprimir.
